common_prompt: Create one complete full-body fashion illustration of exactly one adult woman aged 24, with adult facial structure and balanced adult proportions. The required outfit combination is: very long flowing hair, visibly multicoloured fingernails, a short frilled dress, fine diamond-pattern fishnet tights covering both legs continuously, and lace ankle boots with clear crisscross ribbon lacing and slender high heels. The layered dress ends at mid-thigh so the upper legs and fishnet pattern are clearly visible. Frilled edges, lace borders and opaque fabric layers must read as coherent garment construction. Keep the skirt covering the pelvis naturally. These must be SHORT ANKLE BOOTS: cuffs stop just above the ankles, not at mid-calf or the knees; show both complete boots, toes and narrow heel silhouettes. Fishnet must remain visibly mesh rather than opaque plain tights. Nails alternate three readable colours on naturally posed fingers: one hand near her hair or face, the other near her waist or resting on a nearby railing with nails turned toward the viewer. Hair flows behind the figure without hiding the footwear. Elegant natural standing pose, credible knees and ankles, feet modestly apart, eye-level camera and clear ground contact. Give the figure most of the portrait frame with breathing room below the heels. Reference image supplies artistic rendering only, never copy its person, costume, props or scene. No extra people, text, logo, signature, watermark, panels or inset portraits.

jobs.title: 酒红夜玫瑰
jobs.prompt: She has waist-length auburn hair, emerald eyes and a composed warm smile. Her dress is deep burgundy and black with a fitted satin waist, crisp layered frills and rose-pattern lace. Fine BLACK fishnet tights are clearly outlined against the softly lit skin. Black lace ankle boots have plum crisscross satin ribbons, scalloped lace cuffs, pointed toes and elegant needle-thin heels. Her nails alternate crimson, lavender and emerald. One hand brushes hair behind her ear while the other rests against her waist. Place her in a refined evening rose salon: dark wood panels, warm brass lamps, a velvet stool and a tall window with rain outside. Preserve rich red and black intrinsic colours under neutral warm light with restrained cool edge accents; emphasize clean connected contours and readable satin versus lace texture.

jobs.title: 薄荷晨光花房

jobs.title: 奶油玫瑰庭院
jobs.prompt: She has waist-length chestnut hair tied loosely with a cream ribbon, warm hazel eyes and an easy natural smile.
